content.title: Pyramids & Luxor Discovery
content.summary: A six-day journey through Cairo and Luxor, exploring the Pyramids, Islamic Cairo, grand temples and royal tombs, with overnight sleeping trains in both directions.
content.description:
Discover the extraordinary legacy of ancient Egypt on a captivating six-day journey through Cairo and Luxor, two of the country's most remarkable historical destinations. From the legendary Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx to the magnificent temples and royal tombs of Luxor, this carefully planned itinerary offers an unforgettable introduction to the civilization of the pharaohs, while revealing the rich cultural heritage of historic Cairo. Your adventure begins in Egypt's vibrant capital, where the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World awaits. Stand before the monumental Pyramids of Giza, admire the mysterious Great Sphinx, and experience the remarkable achievements of a civilization that continues to inspire travelers from around the world. Beyond the ancient monuments, discover the fascinating streets of Islamic Cairo. Explore architectural masterpieces such as the Mosque of Sultan Hassan, Al-Rifa'i Mosque, and the historic Mosque of Ahmed Ibn Tulun. Wander through the atmospheric Al-Muizz Street and the bustling Khan El Khalili Bazaar, where Cairo's centuries-old trading traditions remain part of everyday life. Your journey then continues south aboard an overnight sleeping train to Luxor, often described as the world's greatest open-air museum. Here, discover the magnificent temples of Karnak and Luxor on the East Bank of the Nile, followed by an exploration of the royal burial grounds and impressive monuments of the West Bank. Walk through the legendary Valley of the Kings, admire the striking Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and stand before the towering Colossi of Memnon - extraordinary reminders of Egypt's ancient power and artistic achievements. With guided sightseeing, arranged transfers, overnight train journeys, and visits to some of Egypt's most celebrated archaeological sites, this six-day experience brings together the country's ancient history and living culture in one rewarding journey.

All meals are included, from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included on every full day in between.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Cairo
itinerary.description:
Your Egyptian adventure begins upon arrival at Cairo International Airport, where our representative will welcome you and assist with your arrival arrangements. Enjoy your transfer to the hotel, where you can settle in and prepare for the remarkable discoveries ahead. Cairo is the starting point for a journey that will take you from the ancient monuments of Giza to the magnificent temples and royal tombs of Luxor.

Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: The Great Pyramids of Giza & the Sphinx
itinerary.description:
Today, step back thousands of years as you travel to the legendary Giza Plateau, home to some of the most recognizable monuments in the world. Stand before the extraordinary Pyramids of Giza, monumental achievements of ancient engineering that have fascinated visitors for generations. Continue to the Great Sphinx, the iconic limestone monument with the body of a lion and the head of a human, standing guard over this remarkable archaeological landscape. After your sightseeing experience, enjoy lunch before returning to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax or spend time at leisure in Cairo.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner

itinerary.title: Islamic Cairo's Historic Treasures & Overnight Train to Luxor
itinerary.description:
Discover another fascinating side of Egypt as you explore the architectural masterpieces and historic streets of Islamic Cairo. Begin with a visit to the magnificent Mosque of Sultan Hassan, celebrated for its imposing architecture and grand proportions. Continue to the neighboring Al-Rifa'i Mosque before exploring the historic Mosque of Ahmed Ibn Tulun, one of Cairo's oldest surviving mosques. Your journey through Cairo's heritage continues along Al-Muizz Street, a remarkable historic thoroughfare lined with monuments and buildings that reflect centuries of Islamic architecture. Experience the lively atmosphere of Khan El Khalili Bazaar, where traditional shops, narrow streets, and local commerce offer a memorable glimpse into Cairo's cultural traditions. After lunch, transfer to Cairo Railway Station to board your overnight sleeping train to Luxor.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Sleeping train to Luxor

itinerary.title: Luxor's Magnificent East Bank Temples
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Luxor Railway Station and prepare to explore one of the most extraordinary archaeological destinations in the world. Your sightseeing begins on the East Bank of the Nile with a visit to the magnificent Karnak Temple complex, one of the largest religious complexes ever constructed. Walk among its monumental columns, impressive gateways, and ancient ceremonial spaces, and discover the extraordinary architectural achievements of Egypt's pharaohs. Continue to Luxor Temple, another remarkable monument that played an important role in the religious and ceremonial life of ancient Thebes. Admire its magnificent statues, towering columns, and impressive architectural features while discovering the history behind this celebrated sanctuary. Following your guided visits, enjoy lunch before transferring to your hotel in Luxor.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Luxor hotel

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple & Colossi of Memnon
itinerary.description:
Today, venture to Luxor's legendary West Bank, where the ancient Egyptians created some of their most remarkable funerary monuments. Begin with a visit to the Valley of the Kings, the famous burial ground of the New Kingdom pharaohs. Discover the fascinating history of the royal tombs, hidden within the rugged hills of the Theban necropolis. Continue to the spectacular Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, one of Egypt's most distinctive ancient monuments. Built against the dramatic cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, this magnificent temple reflects the power and ambition of one of ancient Egypt's most remarkable rulers. Your exploration continues at the Colossi of Memnon, two immense seated statues that have stood on the West Bank for thousands of years. After lunch, transfer to Luxor Railway Station to board your overnight sleeping train back to Cairo.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Sleeping train to Cairo

itinerary.title: Return to Cairo & Final Departure
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Cairo Railway Station, bringing your memorable exploration of Cairo and Luxor to a close. Enjoy free time at leisure until your final departure. As your Egyptian adventure comes to an end, take home lasting memories of the Great Pyramids, the historic streets of Islamic Cairo, the magnificent temples of Luxor, and the extraordinary royal tombs of the Valley of the Kings.

Meals: Breakfast

inclusions: All transfers as specified in the program.
Overnight sleeping train tickets for the Cairo-Luxor and Luxor-Cairo journeys.

Entrance fees to all sites mentioned in the itinerary: Giza Pyramids and Great Sphinx; Mosque of Sultan Hassan; Al-Rifa'i Mosque; Mosque of Ahmed Ibn Tulun; Khan El Khalili Bazaar and Al-Muizz Street; Karnak Temple; Luxor Temple; Valley of the Kings; Temple of Queen Hatshepsut; and Colossi of Memnon.
All meals from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day, including breakfast, lunch and dinner on each full day in between.
exclusions: Any services not mentioned in the program.
content.bookingTerms:
Availability
Tours are available throughout the year except from 24 December to 7 January, inclusive. All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation.

Payment
A deposit of 25% of the total tour price is required upon confirmation. The remaining balance must be paid 30 days before departure.

Cancellation
Cancellation charges are calculated as a percentage of the total tour price, based on the number of days before departure when cancellation is received:
• 60 or more days: no cancellation charge; full refund.
• 59–30 days: 25% of the total tour price.
• 29–15 days: 50% of the total tour price.
• 14–7 days: 75% of the total tour price.
• 6 days or fewer: 100% of the total tour price.
Any refund or outstanding cancellation charge is calculated against the amount already paid.

Children’s policy
Children under 2 years old: free of charge.
Children aged 2 to under 6: 25% of the applicable adult tour price.
Children aged 6 to under 12: 50% of the applicable adult tour price.
Travelers aged 12 or older: full adult tour price.
These child rates apply when sharing a room with parents, with a maximum of one child sharing the parents’ room. If a tour includes airfare, additional child airfare charges may apply. Please contact us to confirm room arrangements and a family quote; the online group-rate calculator currently uses full adult rates.

Date changes
Date changes are available, subject to availability. Administration fees may apply depending on the travel period for which the tour is booked. Please contact us to confirm available dates and any applicable fees before a change is made.

Force majeure
We offer a flexible cancellation approach when travel is affected by circumstances beyond the traveler's control, such as government restrictions, airline disruptions, official do-not-travel warnings, war or civil unrest. Each case is reviewed individually, taking into account the circumstances and applicable supplier arrangements. Please contact us promptly to discuss available cancellation or rescheduling options.
